payload.subject: Re: Expansion to EU teams
payload.body_text:
Hi Marco,
Thanks for joining Thursday. Our mutual NDA went over yesterday; as soon as it's countersigned I'll send our SOC2 Type II report and the latest pen-test summary. To keep the EU timeline on track, could we book a 60-minute security review for Thursday, October 1? Priya, copying you so you have the latest.
Best,
Dana
